content: We initialized MR extraction models' vocabulary from the training dataset after removing words with a frequency lower than 30 in the dataset, resulting in 456 words. Our vocabulary is small because of the size of the dataset, hence we rely on the model's ability to copy words to produce the output effectively. In all our model variations, the embedding and the network's hidden dimension are set to be equal. The networks were trained with a learning rate of 0.0015, dropout of 0.5 on the embedding layer, normal gradient clipping set at 2, batch size of 8, and optimized with Adagrad BIBREF15 and the training was stopped using the $10\%$ validation dataset.
